flight.plan: Parse SAVE<n>, clamp n to 1..50, round to the nearest cent. WELCOME5 unchanged.

intent.title: Support percentage coupon codes
intent.body: applyCoupon should accept codes of the form SAVE<n> (e.g. SAVE10, SAVE25) meaning n percent off, rounded to the nearest cent, with n between 1 and 50. Unknown codes still change nothing; WELCOME5 keeps working. Add tests.
